craft_notes: Sthāyin: begging one thing. Device: end-dash→comma (garner stated softly), colon landing on alms. Rejected: 'boon' for 'alms' — kept alms (beggar's word). Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: From the garner where all cravings sheaf to ripeness,
from thee one alms I sue, Lord, in all wise: love of thee lone to gain.
l4.sanskrit_cite: niḥśeṣaprārthanīyārthasārthasiddhinidhānataḥ tvattas tvadbhaktim evāptuṃ prārthaye nātha sarvathā

reads_against.argmap: From treasury of accomplishment of wholly desirable hosts.; From you, devotion to you alone to obtain I pray, O lord, in every way. → From all-desire treasury, pray only devotion to you.
c1_essence: One begging from all-desire hoard: love of you solely.
reads_against.l2: Out of the hoard where every coveted sheaf ripens — from you I beg one thing, lord, in all wise: love of you solely to win.
